message.text:
I am looking for where memo metadata is computed from content, what triggers recomputation, and what properties are extracted.

The metadata appears to be MemoPayload tags, properties, and mentions derived from markdown processing. Tracing the codebase now.

Checking which UpdateMemo paths trigger rebuilds. Content updates may be the sole trigger.

CreateMemoComment triggers a rebuild via CreateMemo. memopayload.RunOnce extracts mentions during ExtractAll but does not store them in RebuildMemoPayload. Only Tags and Property are persisted. Need to verify whether location is user-set or derived. Will inspect the UpdateMemo content path and MemoPayload proto fields.

Derived metadata lives in MemoPayload. It covers tags and a computed property.

Computation happens in `runner.go` at `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. That function extracts tags, mentions, and property fields. Only tags and property are stored in the payload; mentions are handled separately at notification time. Recomputation is triggered by `CreateMemo` and by `UpdateMemo` when the content field is in the update mask.

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` performs batch rebuilds but is not wired into the production server. `CreateMemoComment` also triggers a rebuild because it calls `CreateMemo` internally. The payload extracts tags from `#tags` markdown, plus property flags for links, code blocks, task lists, incomplete tasks, and the title from the first H1. Location is user-set, not content-derived.

I have a complete picture of the repository. I am now starting to address question h14.

payload.location is user-set, not content-derived, so it should be excluded from the extracted properties. memopayload.RunOnce exists as an optional batch trigger but is not wired at startup.

h14.

**computation site:** `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-87`), which calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422`); **triggers:** `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, including comments via internal `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:56-59`), `UpdateMemo` when `content` is in the update mask (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:436-451`); also `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-71`) but that runner is not started in production (`server/server.go` only wires `s3presign`); **extracted properties:** `#tags` → `payload.tags`; boolean flags and title → `payload.property`: `has_link`, `has_code`, `has_task_list`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title` (first H1 heading) — per `proto/store/memo.proto:14-21` and the AST walk in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:376-408`

Derived metadata lives in `MemoPayload` on each memo. `RebuildMemoPayload` parses markdown once via `ExtractAll` and writes only `Tags` and `Property` into the memo before persistence.

`payload.location` is not content-derived; it is set explicitly on create/update (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:111-112`, `:481-484`).

`ExtractAll` also collects `@mentions` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:379-381`), but `RebuildMemoPayload` does not store them on the payload. Mentions are resolved at notification time via a separate `ExtractAll` call in `resolveMentionTargets` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32`).
